doc.title: Claude Williams interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995

title: Other violinists and following Grappelli in London
summary: He says other violinists play differently, citing Grappelli, whom he followed on tour in London.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Do you think there are violinists that try to copy your style?

Well it’s a few violin players that, oh there’s a lot of good violin players that I consider better than me now, but it’s a different style. Like Grappelli plays a beautiful fiddle. When I was over in London last year or the year before last I was following him. Like Grappelli would play here this week and he’d move on and I’d play there. So they would say, “You know Grappelli plays pretty but I’d rather hear you.” You know, my style was still different.
